newsitem.title: USA: RTRS - Kennecott Copper Utah workers end strike.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Kennecott Copper Utah workers end strike.

text.p: Striking workers at Kennecott Utah Copper Corp returned to their jobs on Friday for the afternoon shift after a brief two-day strike, a company official said.
Louie Cononelos, Kennecott's director of government and public affairs, also said talks were continuing on Friday between the company and the United Steelworkers.
Workers struck the company on Wednesday. A three-year contract expired on Sept 30.
Kennecott, which is a unit of RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd , is seeking a six-year accord. During the strike Kennecott operated its facilities with non-union staffers at a reduced level of production.
The company had announced early Friday that the workers would return to their jobs for the 3 p.m. MDT shift (1700 EDT / 2100 GMT).
